name: two-person-approve
title: Two-Person Approve
description: Approval UI for high-risk actions that surfaces the two-person rule: the requester can't approve their own request here, approval is tied to a fingerprint of the exact plan so edits need re-review, rejections need a reason, and expired requests can't be approved.

meta.stops: Helps prevent a requester approving their own risky change
meta.summary: Review screen for the two-person rule: it shows the exact plan, hides Approve from the requester, and flags edits made after review.
meta.server: Enforce it on the server: reject approvals from the requester or non-approvers, bind the approval to a server-side hash of the exact plan, and refuse expired requests.
catches: The requester trying to approve their own request
Someone not on the approver list
A plan edited after review (fingerprint changed), with changed lines marked
limits: UI only: who may approve and whether the plan changed must be checked by your server
The fingerprint is FNV-1a (8 hex digits), a change detector, not a cryptographic hash
Expiry uses the client clock unless you pass now
a11y: Section labelled by its title; plan <pre> is described by the changed-plan notice
Changed lines have a sr-only "Changed:" prefix
Outcome and expiry use role=status; changed-plan notice is a polite live region
Reason textarea has a <label>, aria-invalid when missing, and receives focus on reject
